entry_reference.live_paper_trader: live Binance spot ticker price at the moment the cycle opens the position (minutes after the signal bar closed), +/- slippage; NOT signal-bar close, NOT next-bar open
entry_reference.paper_ledger (paper.py): signal bar CLOSE (df.close.iloc[-1]); exits evaluated from the following bar
entry_reference.signal_paper/confluence_paper: next 15m bar OPEN after the signal bar

sl_method.live_paper_trader: atr_mult(2.0) of ATR14(1h) from fill, then breakeven(frac=0.67, buffer_pct=0.3)
sl_method.llm_proposed: price_level (hakem/entry JSON 'stop'; prompt asks to align with swing/FVG/VWAP/POC/pivot levels; not used by live trader)

tp_method.live_paper_trader: atr_mult(3.0) of ATR14(1h) from fill (single target, no partials)

live_paper_trader (trader.py).position_size_rule: risk 1.0% of equity per stop distance (stop dist + 2*(fee+slip)); margin cap 20.0% of equity x leverage_cap; min notional $10
live_paper_trader (trader.py).stop_trigger: 1-minute candle high/low since last check (monitor every ~120s) -> intrabar wick triggers stop
live_paper_trader (trader.py).stop_priority: stop before target if both in same pass

paper_ledger (paper.py, outputs/ledger.j.stop_trigger: bar low/high of subsequent bars of the SAME interval (1h wick)

llm_layer.summary: Direction (BUY/SELL/HOLD; LONG/SHORT; YUKARI/ASAGI) is chosen by LLM calls. Deterministic code only gates, sizes, sets ATR stops and executes.

teknik_analist.enters: commentary + 'EĞİLİM: BOĞA|AYI|NÖTR' tag (tag used only for per-agent hit-rate stats, paper.stance)

hakem.enters: JSON {karar BUY|SELL|HOLD, guven 0-100, stop, hedef, gerekce, maddeler}
hakem.used_by: trader.cycle (karar, guven -> open if >= min_confidence and equals MTF karar); risk_rules (hakem.stop if valid); hakem.hedef is the ledger target in paper.py

risk_llm.used_by: stored in run output only; run.finish()/trader do not read it (backtest note: 'canlıda işlem kararını etkilemiyor')

entry_ltf.enters: JSON {giris LONG|SHORT|YOK, guven, stop, hedef, gerekce}
entry_ltf.note: its stop/hedef are not used by the live paper trader (ATR multiples used)

prompt_files: agents.py (all role prompts: RULE, PAT, KL, mode(), technical, sentiment, bull, bear, judge, risk, trend_4h, entry_ltf)
lessons.py (lesson block text injected into judge/MTF prompts)
llm_layer.provider_chain: config.json providers: gemini -> openrouter (-> ollama disabled); role quick/deep model per provider; actual responder recorded per step in run 'providers'

parameters.atr14: simple rolling mean (14) of True Range
parameters.candle_policy: klines() drops candles whose close_time >= now (only CLOSED candles)
parameters.date_field: candle OPEN time, UTC ('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'; 1d = date only)

conditions: universe(): keep symbols ending with quote; drop base in exclude+exclude_meme; drop leveraged-token suffixes; drop non-ASCII base if exclude_non_ascii; vol = Binance spot quoteVolume + OKX USDT-M perp volume must be >= min_quote_vol_24h; spot quoteVolume>0 and trade count>0; sort by vol desc, keep universe_size
main(): if require_okx_perp -> drop symbols without OKX perp (scan.py:93); if min_listing_days -> drop listings younger than that (scan.py:96-100)
main(): thr = max(min_atr_pct[interval], percentile(atr_%, low_vol_percentile)); atr_% < thr -> dropped; |24h change| > max_abs_chg_24h_% -> dropped; quote_vol_24h < min -> dropped

parameters.trend(): +1 if close>sma50 and sma50[-1]-sma50[-6]>0; -1 mirror; else 0

deterministic_rules.note: inputs are LLM outputs (trend_4h.trend, entry.giris); the combination rule itself is deterministic
conditions: aligned = (trend=='YUKARI' and giris=='LONG') or (trend=='ASAGI' and giris=='SHORT')
if aligned: karar = BUY if giris=='LONG' else SELL; else karar = HOLD
guven = min(trend_4h.guven, entry.guven) if aligned else None
require_mtf -> MTF must be aligned
hakem.karar must be BUY/SELL and equal MTF karar and hakem.guven >= min_confidence
blocked if open positions >= max_concurrent, or realized_since(day_start()) <= -daily_loss_limit*equity, or symbol already open
SELL opens a SHORT only if allow_short

deterministic_rules.note: LLM stop/hedef are NOT passed to open_position; stop/target are ATR multiples only

formulas.fill: ref=live Binance spot ticker at order time; LONG fill=ref*(1+slippage), SHORT fill=ref*(1-slippage)

conditions: every monitor pass: high/low of 1-MINUTE candles since last check (+ last price); stop hit if low<=stop (LONG) / high>=stop (SHORT) -> WICK triggers, not candle close
stop and target in same pass -> stop wins
stop fill = min(stop,last) LONG / max(stop,last) SHORT; target fill = target; both then slippage against us + fee
time exit after max_hold_hours at last price
breakeven: be_progress = (best price seen - entry)/(target - entry) (SHORT mirrored); when >= be_trigger_frac, stop -> entry*(1 +/- be_buffer_pct/100) (be_level), once, only if it improves the stop
stop = LLM hakem.stop if valid (below price and >= 0.5*ATR away) else price - ATR_MULT[interval]*ATR (stop_kaynak 'hakem' or 'ATR×k')
size = min(equity*1%/(price-stop)*price, equity*50%)
blocked if realized_today <= -2% equity; blocked if karar != BUY (long/cash only)
entry = signal bar CLOSE (price=df.close.iloc[-1]); status 'open' only if karar=='BUY' and size_usd>0 and not blocked
exits checked on bars AFTER signal bar: low<=stop -> stop; high>=hedef -> hedef; else time exit after HORIZON bars at close
bar-level (wick) check; stop checked before target within the same bar
classify(4h candle, level): close<level -> 'alt' (bear break); low<level<=close -> 'tepki' (bull reaction); else 'üst'
funding: fmax = max-|abs| funding across venues (8h-equiv %); |fmax|>=FUND_TH -> fsc = -1 if fmax>0 else +1
score = sc4 + fsc; >=2 LONG egilimli, <=-2 SHORT egilimli, else NOTR
NEWLONG p>=+0.5 & oi>=+1; NEWSHORT p<=-0.5 & oi>=+1; LONGLIQ p<=-0.5 & oi<=-1; SQUEEZE p>=+0.5 & oi<=-1; OFOI_UP/DN |oi|>=3; FUND_POS/NEG |funding 8h-eq|>=0.05%
windows w in {4,16} x 15m; entry = NEXT 15m bar OPEN after signal bar; exit = close of bar j+H, H in {4,16,48}; cost 10bp round trip; baseline = other coins same window
HTF line proxies (EMA50, EMA100, Supertrend(10,3), Bollinger mid SMA20) on 2h candles from last CLOSED 2h bar
touch: 15m low<=line (dir +1) or high>=line (dir -1) after a bar fully on trend side; 16-bar refractory
entry = next 15m bar open; cost 10bp round trip
